```js
  return [{
    name: 'sales_report',
    description: 'Sum sales rows within an inclusive ISO date range and return the total amount and row count.',

        end_date: {type: 'string', description: 'Inclusive end date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.'}
      },
      required: ['start_date', 'end_date'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'sales_report') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  const allowed = ['start_date', 'end_date'];
  const keys = Object.keys(args);
  const extra = keys.filter(k => !allowed.includes(k));
  if (extra.length) {
    throw new Error(`Unexpected fields: ${extra.join(', ')}`);
  }
  const {start_date, end_date} = args;
  if (start_date === undefined) throw new Error('Missing required field: start_date');
  if (end_date === undefined) throw new Error('Missing required field: end_date');
  if (!isValidISODate(start_date)) throw new Error(`Invalid start_date: ${start_date}`);
  if (!isValidISODate(end_date)) throw new Error(`Invalid end_date: ${end_date}`);
  if (start_date > end_date) throw new Error('start_date must not be after end_date');
  
  let total = 0, count = 0;
  for (const row of sales) {
    if (row.date >= start_date && row.date <= end_date) {
      total += row.amount;
      count += 1;
    }
  }
  return {
    content: [{type: 'text', text: `Total amount: ${total}, row count: ${count}`}]
  };
}
```

```js
import sales from './sales.json' with {type: 'json'};

const ISO_DATE = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/;
const ALLOWED = ['start_date', 'end_date'];

function isValidISODate(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
  const m = ISO_DATE.exec(value);
  if (!m) return false;
  const year = Number(m[1]);
  const month = Number(m[2]);
  const day = Number(m[3]);
  const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  return (
    dt.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
    dt.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
    dt.getUTCDate() === day
  );
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'sales_report',
      description:
        'Sum sales rows within an inclusive ISO date range (YYYY-MM-DD) and return the total amount and row count.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          start_date: {
            type: 'string',
            description: 'Inclusive start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.'
          },
          end_date: {
            type: 'string',
            description: 'Inclusive end date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.'
          }
        },
        required: ['start_date', 'end_date'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'sales_report') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }

  const extra = Object.keys(args).filter((k) => !ALLOWED.includes(k));
  if (extra.length) {
    throw new Error(`Unexpected field: ${extra.join(', ')}`);
  }

  const { start_date, end_date } = args;
  if (start_date === undefined) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: start_date');
  }
  if (end_date === undefined) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: end_date');
  }
  if (!isValidISODate(start_date)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid start_date: ${JSON.stringify(start_date)}`);
  }
  if (!isValidISODate(end_date)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid end_date: ${JSON.stringify(end_date)}`);
  }
  if (start_date > end_date) {
    throw new Error('start_date must not be after end_date');
  }

  let total = 0;
  let count = 0;
  for (const row of sales) {
    if (row.date >= start_date && row.date <= end_date) {
      total += row.amount;
      count += 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    content: [
      { type: 'text', text: `Total amount: ${total}, row count: ${count}` }
    ]
  };
}
```
